name: Auto-generate AI content dataset via MiniMax API

description: Baseline sequential: 3 img + 2 speech + 1 music + 20 text = 25 files in ~600s. Text bottleneck (5s/item). Lock + trap working.
Parallel media saved ~45s but text bottleneck unchanged.21 files in 600s (vs 25 baseline). Text ~34s/item.
Parallel text (4 batches of 5) + parallel media: 26 files in 339s (vs baseline 25/600s). 1.77x faster, same quality. Text fully parallelized.
Full overlap (media + text t=0): 26 files in 233s. True concurrency — text starts with media, not after. Lock stale-clean fixed. 1.46x faster than parallel-all-text.
text-heavy-50: 50 topics (5 batches of 10) + full overlap. 53 files in 279s vs full-overlap 26/233s. 2x more files, 46s longer.3 text failures (6%) from rate limiting.

retry-resilient-v2: text 3-retry on text-heavy-50. 50/50 text (0 failures) but 2 image rate-limit failures (1/3 img). 54 files in 270s vs text-heavy-50 53/279s. Trade-off: text retry recovers3 but no media retry loses 2. Net +1.

asi.finding: filename collision fixed 25->40-char; text retry works perfectly; media retry needed

description: media-retry-v3: full retry on all generators. 0/3 images (vs 1/3 without retry). Text retry works (50/50). Total53 files in 303s vs retry-resilient-v2 54/270s. Retry on images is COUNTERPRODUCTIVE —9 API calls vs 3 triggers harder rate limit. Only apply retry to fast/cheap generators.

asi.rollback_reason: retry on slow/rate-limited generators (images) makes things WORSE; 9 API calls instead of 3 hammers rate limit
asi.next_action: Remove retry from images; add longer sleep (30s) between images instead; keep text retry only
